DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談でしょうか。お子さんもご一緒ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to discuss something? Your child is with you, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが制服を見ると怖がります。悪いことをした時だけ警察の方が来ると思っているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 制服を怖がる子が警察を叱る役だけと思っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child gets frightened when they see a uniform. They seem to think police officers only come when someone has done something wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child fears uniforms and thinks the police only scold people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いま、お子さんはお話を聞きたい様子ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your child seem interested in listening just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し離れたところなら聞きたいそうです。無理に窓口の前へ連れてくるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子が望む距離で話を聞き無理に近づけないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say they would like to listen from a little way away. I don't intend to force them up to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the child will listen from their preferred distance and you will not force them closer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そこからで構いません。道に迷った方のお手伝いもする、と短くお話ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: They can stay there. Shall I briefly explain that we also help people who have lost their way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。叱るために来たのではないことが分かれば、少し安心できると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 叱責の場面でないと安心できる短い仕事説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I think they will feel a little more at ease if they understand you haven't come to scold them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a brief explanation of the officer's work that reassures the child this is not a scolding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は何か困った出来事の相談ではなく、お仕事について知りたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So today you want to learn about our work, rather than discuss a troubling incident?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。事件の話ではありません。子どもが質問したくなったら、自分の言葉で聞けるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事件相談ではなく子自身が質問できる機会を希望すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. This isn't about a crime. If my child wants to ask a question, I want them to be able to ask in their own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say this is not a report about a crime and you want the child to have a chance to ask their own questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらから近づかず、この距離で挨拶します。こんにちは。お話を聞いてくれてありがとう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll greet you from here without coming closer. Hello. Thank you for listening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもが小さく挨拶できました。今日はここまでにして、家でも困った時に相談する仕事だと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子が挨拶でき当日はここまでにして家庭でも説明すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: My child managed a quiet greeting. We'll stop here for today, and at home I'll also explain that your job includes helping people when they have a problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the child managed a greeting, decide to stop for today, and explain the work at home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 挨拶できてよかったですね。それでは、親子でお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad your child could say hello. Take care on your way home, both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have anything to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は発送ではなく、子どもが郵便の仕事を知りたくて来ました。見学について尋ねてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送でなく子どもの郵便の仕事の見学相談と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: We aren't sending anything today. My child wanted to learn about postal work, so we came here. May I ask about a visit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are asking about a child's visit to learn about postal work, not sending a parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見学のご相談は担当へ確認が必要です。お子さんは、何を知りたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will need to check with the person in charge about visits. What would your child like to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手紙がどうやって行先ごとに分かれるのかを知りたいそうです。作業中の場所へ今すぐ入りたいということではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕分けに興味があり当日の作業場立入り希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They want to know how letters get sorted by destination. We aren't asking to enter the work area right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the interest in sorting and that you are not requesting entry to the work area today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見学を受け付けているか、質問だけでもできるかを担当へお問い合わせいただく形になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to contact the person in charge to ask whether visits are available, or whether questions alone can be accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもの質問を短く書いて、問い合わせたいです。家族での見学ができるかも一緒に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子の質問を整理し家族見学と質問受付を問い合わせたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'd like to write my child's questions down briefly and enquire. I'll also ask whether family visits are possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to organize the child's questions and enquire about family visits and whether questions are accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人数と希望時期もお伝えになるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would also help to give the number of people and your preferred time of year.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 親子二人で、次の学校の休みに希望しています。日程はまだ決めていないので、受付があるかを先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 親子二人で次の学校休み希望だが日程未定と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would be the two of us, parent and child, and we'd like the next school holiday. We haven't set a date, so I'll first check whether visits are accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that two people, parent and child, hope to visit during the next school holiday but have no date yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが問い合わせ先です。本日の窓口では見学の予約は承っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the contact details. This counter does not take bookings for visits today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を控えました。子どもと質問を整理してから連絡します。今日は見学の約束ができたとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約未成立と理解し連絡先を控えて質問整理後に問い合わせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the contact details. I'll contact them after organizing the questions with my child. I'll make sure not to say we've arranged a visit today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show that you understand no booking has been made, note the contact details, and decide to enquire after organizing questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へご相談ください。お仕事に関心を持ってくださってありがとうございます。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with the person in charge. Thank you for taking an interest in our work. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご入金の記録をご確認になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking the record of a deposit, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めての給料が入っているか、見に来ました。通帳に記録が出ていて、働き始めたことをやっと実感しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初給与の入金確認に来て働き始めた実感を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to see whether my first salary had arrived. Seeing the entry in my bankbook finally makes it feel real that I've started working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came to check your first salary deposit and describe how starting work now feels real. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お仕事を始められたのですね。記録の中で、確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you've started a job. Is there anything in the record you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この入金が給料だと思います。金額だけで決めず、会社からもらった明細と日付を比べて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給与と思われる入金の日付と会社の明細を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think this deposit is my salary. Rather than judging by the amount alone, I'd like to compare the date with the payslip from my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the date of the apparent salary deposit with your company's payslip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳の入金記録と、会社の明細をご自身でご確認ください。給与の詳しい計算は会社へのお問い合わせになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the deposit entry in your bankbook against the company's payslip yourself. You'll need to ask your company about detailed salary calculations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。明細に書かれた振込額と、この記録は合っています。何に使うかは、すぐに決めずに考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明細の振込額との一致を確認し使途を即決しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The transfer amount on the payslip matches this entry. I'd like to think before deciding straight away what to spend it on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the entry matches the payslip's transfer amount and say you will not immediately decide how to use it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 初めてのお給料ですから、いろいろなお気持ちがあるでしょうね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's your first salary, so you must have all sorts of feelings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: うれしいです。最初は全部家族へ送ろうと思いましたが、こちらの生活も始まったばかりなので、家族と話してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初給与の喜びと生活費も考え家族へ送る額を話し合う希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm happy. At first I thought I'd send it all to my family, but I've only just started living here too, so I'll decide after talking with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express happiness about your first salary and a wish to discuss how much to send your family while considering living expenses too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お金の使い道は、ご自身の生活の予定も見ながらお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consider how to use your money in light of your own living plans as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は入金を確認できたことを家族に報告します。送金の手続きはまだ頼まず、まず初めての給料をもらった気持ちを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日は入金確認を家族へ報告し送金手続きはまだ依頼しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll tell my family I've confirmed the deposit. I won't request a transfer yet; first I want to tell them how it feels to receive my first salary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to report the confirmed deposit to your family today without requesting a transfer yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お仕事の最初のお給料、うれしい節目ですね。それでは、ご家族へのお話も楽しんでください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your first salary from your job is a happy milestone. Enjoy talking with your family. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物をお選びですか。用途をお聞きしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing fruit? May I ask what it is for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明後日の交流会で、一人ずつ持ち帰ってもらう果物を探しています。今日すぐ食べるものとは選び方が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明後日の交流会で各自が持ち帰る果物の選び方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for fruit for everyone to take home individually after a gathering the day after tomorrow. Should I choose differently from fruit to eat today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to choose fruit for each person to take home from a gathering the day after tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品によって食べ頃や保存の扱いが違います。何人分をご用意されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ripeness and storage requirements vary by product. How many people are you providing for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十人くらいの予定ですが、まだ確定していません。大きな袋を一つ買えば足りるかと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数が十人程度で未確定と説明し袋買いを検討していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're expecting about ten people, but it's not confirmed yet. I thought buying one large bag might be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that about ten people are expected but the number is unconfirmed, and you are considering buying a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の中の個数もご確認ください。一人一個なら、必要な人数が分かると選びやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check how many pieces are in the bag too. If everyone gets one, knowing the number of people will make choosing easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 主催者に人数を確認します。それから、この果物が明後日までどう置けるか、表示を一緒に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主催者へ人数確認し保存表示も一緒に見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the number with the organizer. Then I'd like to look at the label together to see how to keep this fruit until the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the number with the organizer and ask to look at the storage label together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに保存についての表示があります。食べ頃は個体差もあるので、全部同じになるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The storage information is here. Ripeness varies between individual fruits, so they may not all be ready at the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部が同じ日に食べ頃になると約束せず、持ち帰る人にも表示を確認してもらうようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食べ頃の個体差を理解し受取者にも表示確認を促すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't promise that they will all be ripe on the same day, and I'll ask the people taking them home to check the label too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand individual differences in ripeness and will encourage recipients to check the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要数が決まりましたら、袋の個数と照らしてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know how many you need, compare that with the number of pieces in the bags when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人数の返事を待ってから買います。今日は先に候補を見て、持ち帰りに向いたものを主催者へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加人数の返事後に必要数を選び候補を主催者へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for the reply about numbers before buying. Today I'll look at possible choices first and discuss suitable fruit to take home with the organizer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to choose the needed quantity after the attendance reply and discuss possible choices with the organizer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、候補が決まりましたら、またお声掛けください。それでは、ごゆっくりお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let me know when you've decided on a candidate. Take your time choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: たこをお持ちですね。まだ糸は出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a kite with you. You haven't let the string out yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。初めて揚げるので、まず使ってよい場所を聞こうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用で初めてのたこ揚げが可能な場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. This is my first time flying one, so I thought I'd first ask where I'm allowed to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where a first-time kite flyer may fly, explaining you have not used it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路では糸を広げないでください。園内の案内を確認して、使える場所があるかご相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't spread the string across the path. Let's check the park information and discuss whether there is somewhere you can use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここでは袋に入れたままにします。木や電線の近くを避けるだけで、どこでも使えるわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路では収納したままにし障害物を避けるだけで許可とは思わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll keep it in the bag here. So avoiding trees and power lines alone doesn't mean I can use it anywhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it packed on the path and do not assume avoiding obstacles alone means permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。今日は風も強くなっています。慣れている方とご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. The wind is also getting strong today. Are you with someone experienced?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人です。操作に自信がないので、場所が使えても今日は練習を見送るかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で操作に自信がなく強風で練習見送りも考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm alone. I'm not confident I can control it, so even if the space is available, I may skip practicing today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are alone and not confident controlling it, and are considering skipping practice because of strong wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に始めなくて結構です。案内をご覧になって、また準備して来ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You don't have to force yourself to start. You can read the information and come back another time prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は案内を確かめるだけにします。次は経験のある友人と、風の穏やかな日に相談して来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は案内確認のみとし経験者と穏やかな日の再訪を計画する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I'll just check the information. Next time I'd like to discuss it with an experienced friend and come on a day with light wind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Plan to check information only today and return with an experienced person on a calm day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りの前に、糸や部品が袋から出ていないかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before leaving, please also check that no string or parts are sticking out of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部袋の中にあります。使える場所がない時は、ここで揚げずに別の機会にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部品を収納確認し使用可能な場所がなければ揚げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Everything is in the bag. If there is no permitted place, I won't fly it here and will leave it for another occasion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm all parts are packed and say you will not fly the kite if there is no permitted area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、たこをしまったままお気をつけてお帰りください。次の準備ができましたら、またご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the kite packed and take care on your way home. Come and ask again when you're ready for next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車の前に、何かご案内が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need any information before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母に到着したと電話したいです。でも、まだ家には着いていません。列へ進む前に、立ち止まって連絡できる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅ではなく駅到着を母へ伝えるため立ち止まれる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to phone my mother to tell her I've arrived. But I haven't reached home yet. Before I join the line, please tell me where I can stop to call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can stop to tell your mother you have arrived at the station, not at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの通行を妨げない所でお話しください。お母様が駅へ迎えに来られるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please speak here where you won't block people's way. Is your mother coming to meet you at the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、家で待っています。「着いた」だけだと、もう家の前にいると思わせそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎えではなく母は自宅で待ち到着の意味を誤解させそうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, she's waiting at home. If I only say I've arrived, she might think I'm already outside the house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother is waiting at home, not coming to meet you, and might misunderstand what arrival means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今いる場所と、これからの移動を分けてお伝えになるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would help to explain your current location separately from your onward journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 岡谷駅まで戻り、これから自宅へ向かうと伝えます。帰宅した時には、改めて知らせるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅到着と自宅への移動を分け帰宅後にも知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell her I'm back at Okaya Station and am heading home now. I intend to let her know again when I reach home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish arrival at the station from the trip home and notify her again after reaching home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話を終えてから、駅の案内をご確認ください。移動中に画面を見続けないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After finishing your call, please check the station information. Please don't keep looking at your screen while walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、ここで連絡を終えます。母には、駅に着いたからすぐ食事を用意してほしい、とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: その場で連絡を終え食事準備を急がせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll finish contacting her here. I won't tell her to prepare food immediately just because I've reached the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will finish the call there and will not rush her to prepare a meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自宅までの時間がまだはっきりしないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you're still unsure how long it will take to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その通りです。今いる場所だけ正確に伝え、到着時刻はまだ決めつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地は正確に話し未確定の帰宅時刻を断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Exactly. I'll accurately tell her where I am now and avoid giving a definite arrival time that hasn't been established.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will accurately state your current location and not assert an uncertain arrival time at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらでご連絡をどうぞ。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make your call here. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の情報について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like some advice about local information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越して来たばかりです。近所の集まりに行ってみたいのですが、仕事の休みが毎週同じ曜日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地域の集まりに関心があるが勤務の休みが固定でないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've only just moved here. I'd like to try going to a neighborhood gathering, but my days off work aren't on the same day every week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about local gatherings, explaining your interest and that your days off are not fixed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お探しの集まりの案内はお持ちですか。地域活動の担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a notice for the gathering you're interested in? We can check with the person responsible for community activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内です。最初の回は勤務と重なります。行けないなら、今後も参加できないと思って諦めかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初回は仕事で行けず今後も無理と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this notice. The first session clashes with work. I nearly gave up, thinking that if I couldn't go then, I couldn't take part in future either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that work prevents you attending the first session and you thought future participation would be impossible too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加の条件や次の案内については、活動の担当へお尋ねください。一回の欠席だけで、ご自身で全てを決めなくてもよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask the activity organizer about participation requirements and future notices. You needn't decide everything yourself based on missing one session.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。開催のたびに案内を確認できる方法を知りたいです。毎週必ず行く約束をする前に、勤務の事情も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 継続案内の受け取り方を尋ね毎週参加の約束前に勤務事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'd like to know how I can check notices each time an event is held. I'll explain my work situation before promising to go every week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to receive ongoing notices and explain your work situation before committing to weekly attendance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。どなたかと一緒に参加したいということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that request on to the person in charge. Do you want to participate with someone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まずは一人で見てみたいです。家族全員の参加を申し込むのではなく、自分の関心として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族全員ではなく自分一人の関心として相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to take a look on my own first. I'm asking because I'm personally interested, rather than registering my whole family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are enquiring out of your own interest alone, not for the whole family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。この案内と、ご相談の内容をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please take this notice and the details of your enquiry with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。最初の回は行けませんが、案内を受け取る方法と参加条件を聞いてから、行ける回を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初回欠席でも条件と案内方法を聞き参加可能な回を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I can't attend the first session, but after asking about notices and participation requirements, I'll consider which sessions I can go to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that despite missing the first session, you will ask about conditions and notices and consider sessions you can attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へご案内します。それでは、地域での新しい生活をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to the person in charge with those details. Enjoy your new life in the community.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受診にあたり、書類についてご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests about documents for your medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ遅れる理由を伝えたいです。病院に来たことが分かる紙を頼まれましたが、全部「診断書」と呼んでよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ来院の確認紙を求められ全て診断書と呼んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to explain to work why I'll be late. They asked for a paper showing I came to the hospital, but is it right to call all such papers medical certificates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether every paper confirming a hospital visit requested by work should be called a medical certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何の情報が必要か、職場の依頼を確認しましょう。依頼の文章はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check what information your workplace needs. Do you have their written request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメッセージです。来院したことを確認したいとあります。病名を全部書いてほしいとは言われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼文には来院確認とあり病名全記載の要求ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the message. It says they want to confirm I visited the hospital. They haven't asked me to have every illness listed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the written request asks for confirmation of a visit, not a full list of diagnoses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 来院の確認と、診療内容を記す書類は分けてご相談ください。用意できる書類や条件は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss confirmation of a visit separately from documents describing medical care. The person in charge will check which documents are available and under what conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。職場には何を求めているか聞き直します。名前が分からないからと、診療情報の入った紙を全部出すつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要情報を職場へ確認し名称不明で全診療情報を出さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll ask my workplace again what they need. I don't intend to hand over every paper containing medical information just because I don't know the document's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the information needed with work and will not disclose all medical information because the document name is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日は、必要な書類の相談として担当へおつなぎできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Today I can connect you with the person in charge to discuss the document you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。実際に用意できるかも確認してから職場へ伝えます。今ここで、すぐ希望どおりの紙が出ると約束はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類の用意可否を聞く前に職場へ即時交付を約束しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll tell work after checking whether it can actually be prepared. I won't promise here and now that I'll immediately get exactly the paper they want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not promise immediate issue to work before asking whether the document can be prepared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療と書類の案内は、担当の確認に沿ってお進めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the responsible staff's guidance for your consultation and documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。遅れる連絡は先に送り、書類は職場の必要情報と病院の取扱いを確かめてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遅刻連絡を先にし書類内容と取扱いを確認して相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first send word that I'll be late, then discuss the documents after checking the information work needs and the hospital's procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report being late first, then check document content and handling before discussing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、受診の案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your request to the person in charge. Please wait for instructions for your consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜、玄関を何度もたたかれました。相手が誰か分からず、今日は家へ帰るのが怖くて、先に相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜の連続ノックで相手不明のため帰宅前に相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Last night someone repeatedly knocked on my front door. I don't know who it was, and I'm afraid to go home today, so I came to ask for help first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came for advice before returning home because of repeated knocking last night by an unknown person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手の姿や言葉は、確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were you able to see the person or make out what they said?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ドアは開けていません。声は聞こえましたが、言葉は分かりませんでした。知人に違いないと決めているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ドアを開けず声の言葉も不明で知人と断定していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't open the door. I heard a voice but couldn't understand the words. I'm not assuming it must have been someone I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you did not open the door, could not understand the spoken words, and do not assume it was an acquaintance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できた内容から伺います。今の帰宅への不安も担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll start with what you were able to confirm. I'll also tell the person in charge you're worried about going home now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。大したことがないと言って帰るより、誰か分からないことと、帰るのが怖いことを話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出来事を小さく扱わず相手不明と帰宅への恐怖を伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than dismissing it as nothing and going home, I want to explain that I don't know who it was and am frightened to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to explain the unknown person's identity and your fear of returning home without minimizing the incident. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お一人で来られましたか。連絡を取れる方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you come alone? Is there anyone you can contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人です。近くの友人には連絡できますが、相手を確かめに行ってもらうのではなく、私が相談中だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ相談中と知らせるが相手を調べに行かせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm alone. I can contact a nearby friend, but I want to tell them I'm seeking advice, not ask them to go find out who the person was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell a friend you are seeking advice but will not send them to investigate the person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が事情を伺います。ここで安全だと断定するのではなく、今後の対応をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will hear the circumstances. Rather than deciding here that it is safe, please discuss what to do next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人を家へ向かわせず、担当に経過と不安を伝えてから、これからのことを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全を断定せず担当へ経過と不安を話して今後を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't send my friend to the house. I'll explain what happened and my worries to the person in charge, then discuss the next steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume it is safe, but explain the events and concerns to the person in charge and discuss next steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望も引き継ぎます。それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that request on too. Please wait for the person in charge to guide you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの絵を郵送されるご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about posting this drawing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供の絵を祖父へ送りたいです。一枚しかないので、送ったら家には残らないと、今気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 唯一の子供の原画を送ると手元に残らないと気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send my child's drawing to their grandfather. I've just realized there's only one, so if I send it, we won't have it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you realized that sending the child's only original drawing means it will no longer remain with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原画をお送りになるかは、ご家族でお決めください。まだ封はされていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please decide as a family whether to send the original. You haven't sealed it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。祖父にも喜んでもらいたいですが、子供は家の壁に飾りたいと言っていました。その希望を聞かずに持って来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封で子供は家に飾りたいが希望を確認せず持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I'd like their grandfather to enjoy it too, but my child said they wanted it on the wall at home. I brought it here without checking that wish with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is unsealed and you brought it without checking the child's wish to display it at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送を決める前に、ご本人ともお話しになれますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can speak with your child before deciding to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子供に確認します。原画は家に残し、写しを送る案を話してみます。写しなら原画そのものを送ったとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子供へ原画を残し写しを送る案を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask my child. I'll suggest keeping the original at home and sending a copy. If it's a copy, I'll make sure not to say I've sent the original itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the child about keeping the original and sending a copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容が決まりましたら、郵便物の準備についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've decided on the contents, we can explain how to prepare the mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供が写しを送ることに賛成しました。今日は原画を持ち帰り、写しを用意してから発送の相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の賛成を得て原画を持帰り写しを準備後に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My child agreed to sending a copy. I'll take the original home today and come back to ask about posting after preparing a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the child's agreement, will take the original home, and will enquire after preparing a copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。お持ちの原画は、そのままお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll return the original you brought just as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。祖父には子供の絵の写しと説明し、原画は子供の希望どおり家に飾ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 祖父へ写しと説明し原画は家に飾ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll explain to their grandfather that it's a copy of the child's drawing, and display the original at home as my child wishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain to the grandfather that it is a copy and display the original at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日は発送をせず、ご準備後にお越しください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we won't send anything today. Please return once you're ready. Goodbye.
